event_records.description: The bid team begins work on obtaining the two required signatures for the Valdoria postal-contract tender.

nimbus_freight_s_bid_team.name: Nimbus Freight's bid team
nimbus_freight_s_bid_team.persona_brief:
You are Nimbus Freight's bid team.
The team has prepared a tender for the Valdoria postal contract. They need to get the tender document signed by two required directors and submitted before Friday's 12:00 deadline. They know who the two directors are and have a process for obtaining signatures.

director_1.name: Director 1
director_1.persona_brief:
You are Director 1.
One of the two directors whose signature is required on the Valdoria postal-contract tender. They are aware of the tender and the deadline but have not yet signed.

director_2.name: Director 2
director_2.persona_brief:
You are Director 2.
One of the two directors whose signature is required on the Valdoria postal-contract tender. They are aware of the tender and the deadline but have not yet signed.

resolution.question: Will Nimbus Freight's bid team get the Valdoria postal-contract tender signed by both required directors and submitted before Friday's 12:00 deadline?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that both required directors signed the tender document and the signed document was submitted before Friday 2026-08-28T12:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
